climate: Grenache, Syrah and Carignan sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A southern Rhône area containing Châteauneuf-du-Pape, Gigondas, Vacqueyras, Rasteau, Tavel, Lirac and the Côtes du Rhône and Côtes du Rhône Villages appellations. Vineyards in Vaucluse are planted mostly to Grenache (47%), then Syrah (22%).
